runs.reason: Observed: ALT-42EFA95BAA3C reports 998 destination ports from one source in one minute, and ALT-5730B62A74DF reports 996 destination ports in the following minute. Sampled flows FLOW-DB91F9221EF1, FLOW-B2E0C0786879 and FLOW-B7CE43DAC7EA show the same source contacting different destination ports on the same host, each with 2 packets. Inference: this supports network service scanning; authorization and malicious intent remain unverified, and analyst confirmation is required before closure.

findings.observation: The detection reports broad destination-port coverage across consecutive minute groups, consistent with port scanning.
Sampled connections from 172.16.0.1 to 192.168.10.50 target ports 32773, 2002 and 1839 with 2 packets per flow.

technique_mappings.reason: The observed breadth of destination ports supports a suggested Network Service Discovery mapping; flow evidence cannot establish whether the scan was authorized.

next_steps.reason: Inspect connection responses and scan progression to characterize the probing and identify any successful service connections.
Confirm whether this scanning was authorized and explicitly review the PortScan verdict before any closure.
